note: 1x1 conv, one aligned block, small integers. Hand-checkable.

model.doc: One Conv2d. Covers plain / strided / dilated / grouped / depthwise.
model.forward: ReLU / concat / add run in FP32 between quantized layers

mx_format.shared_exp: E = floor(log2(max |x| over the block)), clamped to [-127, 127]; code = E + 127 (unsigned)
mx_format.zero_block: an all-zero block has code 0 (its exponent is undefined)
mx_format.mantissa: round(x * 2**(mant_bias - E)), ties away from zero, then clamped to mantissa_range (an overflow to 2**(mbits-1) keeps E and clamps)
mx_format.blockify: activations: blocks of 32 along W (dim 3), per (n, c, h); a_exp is [N, C, H, ceil(W/32)]. weights: each filter flattened C-major (c, kh, kw) to Cin*kH*kW and cut into blocks of 32 along that stream; w_exp is [O, ceil(Cin*kH*kW/32)]. A tail shorter than 32 is its own block. Conv zero padding is applied AFTER quantization - pad zeros join no block.

accumulator.shift: shift = Ea + Ew - 12 - e_layer_min, with Ea, Ew the real exponents (code - exp_bias). shift >= 0: p << shift; shift < 0: arithmetic p >> -shift (rounds toward -inf)
accumulator.accumulate: acc += shifted p, clamped to the signed 48-bit range after every product (per_product)
accumulator.order: for each input channel c, for each kernel tap (kh, kw): the flattened filter stream, C-major
accumulator.bias: round(b * 2**-e_layer_min), ties to even, added after the last product, then clamped once more
accumulator.output: acc is the layer's integer result; out = acc * 2**e_layer_min in fp32 (lossy above 24 bits - compare acc)

how_to_compare.order: compare in pipeline order - a_int, a_exp, w_int, w_exp, acc, sat - layer by layer; the first mismatch is the root cause, the rest are downstream of it
how_to_compare.note: The int taps are the contract. acc is the bit-exact layer output; alg_*_out is acc cast to fp32 and loses bits above 24. ref_fp32 is the unquantised output, context only.
